title: Recording: Going Down On Love, Whatever Gets You Thru The Night by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon worked on two songs for his Walls And Bridges album on 16 July 1974.

The backing tracks for ‘Going Down On Love’ and ‘Whatever Gets You Thru The Night’ were both laid down during the session. However, ‘Whatever Gets You Thru The Night’ was re-recorded on 17, 23, and 31 July.
